name: WorkspacePanelMediaGeometryContract
rule: FUNCTIONAL MEDIA INFLUENCES PANEL GEOMETRY — media ratio / minimum visual height + copy + controls → panel height (never fixed panel → image forced into slot → crop)

MEDIA_LEAD.geometry: media first at full panel width and its own aspect, copy below
MEDIA_LEAD.tablet: stack or side-by-side by container width

MEDIA_INLINE.geometry: chip thumbnail inline with a row (HUB row grammar: thumb · text · action)
MEDIA_INLINE.mobile: fixed chip from the HUB unit; the grid is content-driven so whole rows show (never a row sliced by a short pane)
MEDIA_INLINE.tablet: rows scroll inside their authored pane

MEDIA_STACK.geometry: media beside copy while the panel is wide enough, stacked above it below the stack width

AUTHORITY_PREVIEW.geometry: dedicated authority slot: whole frame at the approved ratio (contain), inspectable
AUTHORITY_PREVIEW.mobile: spans the full row, panel grows to the preview
AUTHORITY_PREVIEW.tablet: keeps its span; grows to the preview
AUTHORITY_PREVIEW.desktop: keeps its span; grows to the preview

PORTRAIT_GRID.geometry: portrait tiles (4:5) with caption; rail or grid
PORTRAIT_GRID.mobile: fewer, larger tiles per view; the rail stays a horizontal carousel; panel shows one whole tile row

REFERENCE_FRAME.geometry: frames / references at their own aspect (contain or ≤12% trim)

workspacePanelLayouts.verdict: Kept. The six WorkspacePanel layouts describe arrangement; they did not describe how media drives height. Every tab panel (EXPRESSION exf-panel, INBOX cards, ACTIVITY milestone header, WorkspacePanel) now declares a semantic media geometry mode (data-panel-media) — six modes, no one-off pixel modes.

TILE.purpose: tile / card media with a caption (HUB feature / entry card scale)

PREVIEW.purpose: primary media of its panel, inspectable (≥120px tall, or the full row on phones)

legibility.CHIP: short side ≥ HUB row chip (≈18px at 360)
legibility.TILE: short side ≥ HUB smallest card media (≈49px phones, ≈53px tablet / desktop)
legibility.PREVIEW: block ≥ 120px, at the approved aspect; full row on phones

implementations.mobile: Grid marks data-media-geometry="CONTENT" when a panel composed on phones declares functional media: rows become content-sized, the frame scrolls, media-led panels take the full row (REDUCE_COLUMNS)
implementations.tabletDesktop: fractional composition kept; PREVIEW media sit at their approved aspect and only shrink — contained, never cropped — in a short cell

implementations.mobile: ≈3.3 portrait tiles (4:5 headshot slot) per view in the horizontal carousel; panel shows one whole tile row
full row, whole cast node art at 272:110
implementations.tabletDesktop: whole node art at its ratio inside the authored cell

implementations.where: EXPRESSION look / review / storyboard / performance previews
implementations.rule: node art contained at its approved ratio; storyboard frames VIDEO_FRAME contained on dark

implementations.mobile: whole decision authority stacked above the facts
implementations.tabletDesktop: art column kept, frame takes the approved aspect

implementations.mobile: 3:2 frame so node art keeps ≥ half of each axis
whole node art stacked above the title

implementations.rule: block size capped so the mark never leaves its art box (clearspace)
approved F01 screens contained on dark (whole interface)

findings: EXPRESSION grids used minmax(0, Nfr) rows on phones: a media panel could be compressed to any height → replaced by content-driven rows when functional media is present

EXPRESSION .exf-fill previews were flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 40px — the image took whatever was left (shallow strip) → PREVIEW media are flex: none at their aspect on phones, flex: 0 1 auto (contained) in authored cells
the talent rail was flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0 inside a scrolling body shorter than one tile → rail flex: none, the panel grows to one tile row
INBOX / ACTIVITY art used fixed heights (104×122, 150×168, 210×200, 100–150px) → the authority’s approved aspect sets the block size
